#!/bin/sh
set -eu
docker rm -f ji-stage6-performance-final >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
for image in ji-stage6-release-relay:latest ji-stage6-release-web:latest ji-stage6-release-ingress:latest; do
  docker image rm "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done
for directory in "$HOME/ji-stage6-performance" "$HOME/ji-stage6-performance-final" "$HOME/ji-stage6-release"; do
  if test -d "$directory"; then
    docker run --rm -v "$directory:/ji-cleanup" alpine:3.22 sh -eu -c 'rm -rf /ji-cleanup/* /ji-cleanup/.[!.]* /ji-cleanup/..?*'
    rmdir "$directory"
  fi
done
rm -f "$HOME/ji-stage6-source.tar.gz" "$HOME/ji-stage6-package-smoke.sh" \
  "$HOME/build-final-host.sh" "$HOME/build-failed-health-candidate.sh" \
  "$HOME/cleanup-stage6.sh" "$HOME/compare-host-inventory.sh" \
  "$HOME/inspect-active-candidate.sh" "$HOME/inspect-backup-rollback.sh" \
  "$HOME/inspect-host-devices.py" "$HOME/inspect-host-identity.py" \
  "$HOME/inspect-host-inventory-lines.sh" "$HOME/inspect-host-operation.sh" \
  "$HOME/inspect-latest-host-operation.sh" "$HOME/recover-final-host.sh" \
  "$HOME/recover-previous-host.sh" "$HOME/remove-failed-candidate.sh" \
  "$HOME/reset-failed-health-test.sh" "$HOME/run-maven-final.sh" \
  "$HOME/verify-current-host.sh"
remaining=0
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | while IFS= read -r name; do
  case "$name" in ji-stage6-*) printf 'REMAINING_CONTAINER=%s\n' "$name";; esac
done
docker image ls --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | while IFS= read -r image; do
  case "$image" in ji-stage6-*) printf 'REMAINING_IMAGE=%s\n' "$image";; esac
done
for directory in "$HOME"/ji-stage6-*; do
  test -e "$directory" && printf 'REMAINING_PATH=%s\n' "$directory" || true
done
printf '%s\n' STAGE6_FINAL_CLEANUP_OK
